tools.name: get_regime_current
tools.description:
Live market regime: STABLE/VOLATILE + confidence + position_scalar ($0.005).

Validated variance detector: VOLATILE predicts ~2x forward volatility with
~90% persistence. Use for position sizing / risk gating, NOT direction.

tools.description:
Historical regime snapshots, 5-min cadence since 2026-02, 417k+ rows ($0.02).

tools.name: estimate_execution_cost
tools.description:
Realistic execution cost in bps for an order ($0.01).

Calibrated to measured live fills (SPY/QQQ 1.5bps round-trip floor), with
square-root size impact. order_type: limit_nbbo | market.

tools.name: check_bar_quality

Forensic QC on YOUR OHLCV bars before you backtest on them ($0.05).

tools.name: audit_backtest

Forensic audit of a backtest trade ledger ($5.00).

overfitting checks, verdict + grade. trades_csv: CSV text with columns like
symbol, side, entry_time, exit_time, entry_price, exit_price, qty.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_regime_sample, sygnl47_subscribe_live_30d · Private data: sygnl47_events_archive, sygnl47_subscription_plans, sygnl47_subscribe_live_24h, sygnl47_subscribe_live_30d, sygnl47_subscribe_archive_30d · Public sink: get_regime_current, sygnl47_manifest, sygnl47_events_1m, sygnl47_events_archive, sygnl47_entities, sygnl47_feeds, sygnl47_subscription_plans, sygnl47_subscribe_live_24h.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_regime_sample, sygnl47_subscribe_live_30d · Private data: sygnl47_events_archive, sygnl47_subscription_plans, sygnl47_subscribe_live_24h, sygnl47_subscribe_live_30d, sygnl47_subscribe_archive_30d · Public sink: get_regime_current, sygnl47_manifest, sygnl47_events_1m, sygnl47_events_archive, sygnl47_entities, sygnl47_feeds, sygnl47_subscription_plans, sygnl47_subscribe_live_24h

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
